## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

    cancer and specialty care.

    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

## Healing the Body. Honoring the Heart. Empowering the Whole Human.

You are not a collection of symptoms. You are not just a body to be fixed, or a mind to be quieted,
or a heart to be healed. You are all of it — and the work of becoming well has to account for the
whole.

I'm Stephanie Papadakis — holistic nutritionist, grief recovery specialist, and wellness consultant
with over 15 years of experience helping people and organizations move through life's hardest
transitions with clarity, resilience, and renewed purpose.

Whether you're navigating a health crisis, a significant loss, the disorientation of a major life
change, or the quiet burnout of doing too much for too long — this work meets you where you are.

[ LEARN MORE ][43]
 

**What I Offer**

Gut of Integrity is built around one conviction: that physical health and emotional well-being are
not separate concerns.

Nourishment, grief, stress, gut function, hormonal health — they are all part of the same story. My
work brings them into conversation with each other.
* ## Nutrition Consulting
  
  Personalized, functional nutrition support for performance, gut health, hormonal balance,
  autoimmune conditions, and perimenopause. Science-backed, trauma-informed, and built around your
  actual life.
  
  [Learn more][44]
* ## Grief Support
  
  Grief lives in the body. I offer compassionate, structured support for people navigating loss —
  helping you rebuild routines, reconnect with nourishment, and find your footing again.
  
  [Learn more][45]
* ## Corporate Wellness Programs
  
  Workshops, speaking engagements, and custom wellness programs for organizations ready to invest in
  the sustained well-being of their people. Past clients include IDEO and Let’s Reimagine.
  
  [Learn more][46]
* ## Speaking & Workshops
  
  Looking for a speaker who can make nutrition, grief, and wellness accessible and engaging? I offer
  tailored presentations for health summits, podcasts, and community events.
  
  [learn more][47]

## Convenient & Affordable Online Lab Testing

There are many reasons why individuals order lab testing or blood work online. The most common
reasons why people use our services for lab tests online include having a high deductible, having no
insurance or not enough coverage for the testing they want or need. Additionally, millennials are
looking for a viable, affordable alternative to the Affordable Care Act (Obamacare). At
HealthLabs.com, we are able to get you the health and wellness testing you need quickly at an
affordable price.

HealthLabs.com offers an expansive collection of lab test categories and test types at discounted
rates.
* Simply order your blood or urine tests online
* Visit a [local lab][81] near you to give your blood work or urine sample for testing
* And confidentially receive your results in 1-3 days in your secure HealthLabs.com account

Your health is important! Our blood chemistry tests and [wellness tests][82] can help lead to
diagnoses and can point out any potentially problematic results that you can then take to your
doctor or general physician. Order the testing you need and receive your results quickly. We work
with major laboratories, like LabCorp and Quest Diagnostics, as well as smaller, local labs. These
labs are all CLIA-certified and often are the same labs your doctor uses!

Our online lab testing is great for monitoring conditions, disorders and diseases as well as aiding
in helping to make a diagnosis or helping to rule out various diagnoses. We have hundreds of lab
tests to choose. Some of our popular tests include:
* [Cholesterol / Lipid Panel][83]
* [Standard Health Test Panel][84]
* [Comprehensive Health Testing][85]
* [Allergy Testing][86]
* [Vitamin Deficiency Testing][87]

affordable price.

rates.

## Concierge Medicine and Executive Health in Beverly Hills

My Concierge MD is led by Dr. David Nazarian, MD, a board-certified internal medicine physician and
nationally recognized concierge medicine expert based in Beverly Hills, California. Dr. Nazarian’s
work in personalized and preventive healthcare has been featured in major international media
outlets including BBC, CNN, FOX News, Bloomberg, Forbes, USA Today, The New York Times, Newsweek,
People Magazine, and the Los Angeles Times, as well as television programs such as Extra, E! News,
Bravo, KTLA 5, and the Dr. Phil Show, where he has served as a medical contributor and medical
editor.

Dr. Nazarian founded My Concierge MD to provide a more personalized and proactive approach to
healthcare for professionals, executives, and individuals who want direct physician access and a
comprehensive strategy for optimizing their long-term health.

After earning his undergraduate degree from UCLA, Dr. Nazarian received his medical degree from the
Sackler School of Medicine and completed his Internal Medicine residency at Huntington Memorial
Hospital, a USC-affiliated teaching hospital. Today, he combines traditional internal medicine with
advanced preventive diagnostics, regenerative medicine, and longevity science to help patients stay
ahead of disease and perform at their highest level.

## Concierge Medicine and Executive Health in Beverly Hills

My Concierge MD is led by Dr. David Nazarian, MD, a board-certified internal medicine physician and
nationally recognized concierge medicine expert based in Beverly Hills, California. Dr. Nazarian’s
work in personalized and preventive healthcare has been featured in major international media
outlets including BBC, CNN, FOX News, Bloomberg, Forbes, USA Today, The New York Times, Newsweek,
People Magazine, and the Los Angeles Times, as well as television programs such as Extra, E! News,
Bravo, KTLA 5, and the Dr. Phil Show, where he has served as a medical contributor and medical
editor.

Dr. Nazarian founded My Concierge MD to provide a more personalized and proactive approach to
healthcare for professionals, executives, and individuals who want direct physician access and a
comprehensive strategy for optimizing their long-term health.

After earning his undergraduate degree from UCLA, Dr. Nazarian received his medical degree from the
Sackler School of Medicine and completed his Internal Medicine residency at Huntington Memorial
Hospital, a USC-affiliated teaching hospital. Today, he combines traditional internal medicine with
advanced preventive diagnostics, regenerative medicine, and longevity science to help patients stay
ahead of disease and perform at their highest level.

“True health optimization begins with understanding each patient as an individual,” says Dr.
Nazarian. “We don’t just treat symptoms — we identify the underlying factors that influence how you
feel, perform, and age.”

## Regenerative Medicine and Longevity

Modern longevity medicine is built on a deeper understanding of how the body repairs and regenerates
itself. At My Concierge MD, Dr. David Nazarian integrates regenerative medicine with traditional
internal medicine and advanced preventive diagnostics to help patients improve recovery, reduce
inflammation, and support long-term health.

As a board-certified internist practicing concierge medicine in Beverly Hills, Dr. Nazarian
evaluates each patient’s metabolic health, hormone balance, cardiovascular risk factors, and
lifestyle patterns before recommending regenerative therapies. Treatment options may include exosome
therapy, growth factor injections, peptide protocols, hormone optimization, and advanced
longevity-focused interventions, all selected based on clinical evaluation and evidence-based
guidelines.

Rather than waiting for illness to develop, Dr. Nazarian’s approach focuses on early detection,
cellular health, and metabolic optimization, helping patients maintain energy, cognitive
performance, and physical resilience as they age.

For many patients, regenerative and longevity medicine represents a shift from reactive healthcare
to proactive health optimization designed to extend both lifespan and healthspan.

background.]

At My Concierge MD, healthcare begins with understanding the whole patient. Dr. Nazarian conducts
comprehensive evaluations that consider genetics, metabolic health, lifestyle factors, stress
levels, nutrition, and long-term health goals. This broader perspective allows him to design highly
personalized treatment plans that evolve with each patient over time.

# Your mobile  IV rehydration therapy & Wellness service

[BOOK NOW][11]

Elevate your wellness with mobile IV hydration therapy from North Georgia IV and Wellness.
Experience revitalizing treatments delivered to your doorstep, recharging your body and mind
on-demand. Say goodbye to fatigue and dehydration as our experienced professionals bring hydration
and rejuvenation directly to you. Discover the convenience and revitalization of concierge mobile IV
hydration today!

[Untitled design - 2024-01-18T140414.998.png]
[8DC5C0FA-A9C5-446E-B358-52DF1BBAED9B.jpeg]

###### ABOUT US

# Hi. We’re  Rob & Ashley

We have been in the medical field with a combined total of over two decades of experience in
anesthesia, pediatric ER, and preop. We started getting IV drips to help us hydrate and feel better.
But you know what? Who wants to get in a car when you don’t feel good to get an IV? Or, you may just
want to be on your couch with your dog under a blanket. That’s where we come in. We are a concierge
mobile IV service. Whether you are trying to get a beauty bag, a hangover bag, or a variety of
wellness IV bags, we are here to help. These IVs fill you up from the inside out and can really make
a difference in your skin, your mental clarity, or your overall being. So, let us help you to get
back to being present, being well, and being hydrated.

###### STEP BY STEP

# THE  NORTH GEORGIA  IV PROCESS

#### 01

Choose your favorite Drip

At North Georgia IV and Wellness, we offer a range of drips to suit your needs. Whether you're
looking for a boost of energy, hydration, or immunity support, we have a drip that's perfect for
you.

 

#### 02

Secure your slot:

Ready to secure your spot at North Georgia IV and Wellness? Great! We know your time is valuable, so
we're happy to introduce our easy and secure booking process.



#### 03

Confirm your reservation:

Thank you for choosing North Georgia IV and Wellness. We are excited to help you on your journey to
optimal health and wellness. Please confirm your reservation below so we can prepare for your visit.

#### 04

We bring services to you.

At North Georgia IV and Wellness, we understand that taking care of your health can be challenging
with a busy schedule. That's why we bring our services directly to you, wherever you are. We offer
IV therapy and wellness services right to your doorstep.

#### 05

Enjoy your luxury drip!:

Congratulations! You've just received a luxurious IV drip from North Georgia IV and Wellness. We
hope you enjoy the benefits of this treatment and look forward to helping you on your wellness
journey.

## Pharmaceutical Market Data Is Fragmented

Pharmaceutical pricing, registrations, shortages, and supplier data are spread across national
databases, regulatory agencies, and market reports. For procurement teams and pharmaceutical
traders, gathering this information can take hours or days.

Fragmented landscape slows decision-making and limits visibility into international opportunities.

### TEAMS MUST OFTEN
* Search multiple regulatory databases
* Compare pricing between markets
* Identify licensed suppliers
* Monitor product shortages
* Track product registrations and competition

## Meet A Single Platform for Pharmaceutical Market Intelligence

PharmaFootpath aggregates pharmaceutical market data from official sources and organizes it in a
searchable cloud platform. Users can explore pharmaceutical markets in seconds, not hours.

[pill icon]

### Drug Price Comparison

Compare drug prices by country and spot new market opportunities.

[suppliers icon]

### Supplier Discovery

Find licensed distributors and wholesalers globally.

[shortage icon]

### Shortage Monitoring

Monitor medicine shortages and supply disruptions worldwide.

[arrows icon]

### Regulatory Intelligence

Access product registrations and parallel trade licenses.

## See how PharmaFootpath works in your market

Schedule a Demo

## Get Market Clarity in Seconds

### Product Explorer

Review the registration information for multiple countries in a single unified database. Filter
information by MA holders, countries, presentations, strengths, pack sizes, and other
characteristics.

### Price Comparison

Prices are converted to the currency of your choice, with daily updated currency exchange rates.
This lets you compare prices globally in a single screen, immediately.

Order information by prices, or by the largest changes in prices over the last 30 days.

### Clinical Trial Register

Search through multiple clinical trial registers in a single interface, connected to the drug
registration data and market data of PharmaFootpath.

This helps you to select a drug name or API, and then review global clinical trials currently
running with this.

### Drug Shortage Monitoring

Monitoring drug shortages is an important task, but the volume of information can be difficult to
manage.

PharmaFootpath collects and structures shortage information into a single interface, monitoring
trends to highlight the API with which there are increasing supply disruption signals.

## Built for Pharmaceutical Trade and Procurement

### Procurement Teams

Procurement teams can efficiently search multiple markets, compare pricing, and identify suppliers.

### Parallel Traders

Parallel traders can track product registrations, monitor competition, and find arbitrage
opportunities across EU markets.

### Clinical Trial Supply Teams

Clinical trial supply teams can identify global product availability and find new sourcing
opportunities.

### Pharmaceutical Wholesalers

Pharmaceutical wholesalers can find new suppliers, partners, and international trade opportunities.

PharmaFootpath gathers pharmaceutical market data from official national organizations, regulatory
databases, and verified sources. Shortage data is updated daily, and most datasets are refreshed
weekly, so users have the latest information.
* Pharmaceutical pricing
* Product registrations
* Shortages and supply disruptions
* Clinical trials
* Supplier licenses

### [KYBELLA][61]

Kybella is a non-surgical injectable treatment designed to reduce submental fat, commonly known as a
double chin. It contains deoxycholic acid, which breaks down and absorbs fat cells, resulting in a
more contoured and defined jawline over time. The treatment is permanent, as the destroyed fat cells
do not return.

[Learn More ][62]

### [MICRONEEDLING][63]

Microneedling is a minimally invasive skin treatment that uses tiny, fine needles to create
micro-injuries on the skin's surface. This process stimulates the body's natural healing response,
boosting collagen and elastin production. It's commonly used to improve the appearance of fine
lines, acne scars, uneven texture, and overall skin tone. The result is smoother, firmer, and more
youthful-looking skin, with minimal downtime after the procedure.

Why bother

## You have the labs. You don't have *clarity*.

You drew blood. You got back twelve numbers, three red flags, and the feeling that everything is
fine and everything is wrong at the same time. That's the part we rewrite.

01 · Anxiety with no anchor

### The "normal range" isn't *your* range.

Lab reference intervals are built for an averaged population. Your age, sex, lifestyle, history —
none of that fits inside the bracket.

**Before:** "FERRITIN: 28 ng/mL · LOW"
**After:** "second drop in a quarter for you — recheck in 8 weeks"
02 · Charts with no meaning

### Is the line going up *good* or bad?

Most services hand you a stock-ticker chart. But health isn't a portfolio, and "trending up" isn't
always a win.

**Before:** 12-point chart, "↑ +34%"
**After:** "B12 has risen four months running — supplements are working, you can step down the dose"
03 · Advice with no owner

### Recommendations from *nowhere*.

An AI can fire off 14 tips in two seconds. But who decided they fit you? Who's going to do them? Who
checks they worked?

**Before:** "drink 2L of water and move more"
**After:** an 8-week plan with one task per week, and the owner is you
How it works

## Four steps from *PDF* to clarity.

Upload to understanding takes about fifteen minutes. You don't need to read the panel — that's our
job.

01 · INTAKE

#### Five minutes about *you*

Age, sex, goals, lifestyle. Enough for the report to talk to you, not to a "typical patient."

02 · UPLOAD

#### Drop the *PDF*

Any lab, any format. We pick out up to 340 markers. Nothing to type by hand.

03 · READ

#### A report in *sentences*

Not a table — a calm read. What matters, what waits, what to bring up with your doctor.

04 · PLAN

#### One thing *this week*

One task at a time. A vitamin, a recheck in 8 weeks, a consult. No checklist burnout.

## One report. One *link* for your doctor.

Every lab you've uploaded, in one place: the read, the prioritised plan, an overview of five body
systems, and the markers that need attention. Share a link with your doctor or download the PDF —
one click.

"I have three years of labs across three different labs. Used to live in a folder on my disk, things
would slip out of it. Now it's all in one place: I upload, and I stop tracking where the original
lives."

## Healing the Body. Honoring the Heart. Empowering the Whole Human.

You are not a collection of symptoms. You are not just a body to be fixed, or a mind to be quieted,
or a heart to be healed. You are all of it — and the work of becoming well has to account for the
whole.

I'm Stephanie Papadakis — holistic nutritionist, grief recovery specialist, and wellness consultant
with over 15 years of experience helping people and organizations move through life's hardest
transitions with clarity, resilience, and renewed purpose.

Whether you're navigating a health crisis, a significant loss, the disorientation of a major life
change, or the quiet burnout of doing too much for too long — this work meets you where you are.

[ LEARN MORE ][43]
 

**What I Offer**

Gut of Integrity is built around one conviction: that physical health and emotional well-being are
not separate concerns.

Nourishment, grief, stress, gut function, hormonal health — they are all part of the same story. My
work brings them into conversation with each other.
* ## Nutrition Consulting
  
  Personalized, functional nutrition support for performance, gut health, hormonal balance,
  autoimmune conditions, and perimenopause. Science-backed, trauma-informed, and built around your
  actual life.
  
  [Learn more][44]
* ## Grief Support
  
  Grief lives in the body. I offer compassionate, structured support for people navigating loss —
  helping you rebuild routines, reconnect with nourishment, and find your footing again.
  
  [Learn more][45]
* ## Corporate Wellness Programs
  
  Workshops, speaking engagements, and custom wellness programs for organizations ready to invest in
  the sustained well-being of their people. Past clients include IDEO and Let’s Reimagine.
  
  [Learn more][46]
* ## Speaking & Workshops
  
  Looking for a speaker who can make nutrition, grief, and wellness accessible and engaging? I offer
  tailored presentations for health summits, podcasts, and community events.
  
  [learn more][47]

## Convenient & Affordable Online Lab Testing

There are many reasons why individuals order lab testing or blood work online. The most common
reasons why people use our services for lab tests online include having a high deductible, having no
insurance or not enough coverage for the testing they want or need. Additionally, millennials are
looking for a viable, affordable alternative to the Affordable Care Act (Obamacare). At
HealthLabs.com, we are able to get you the health and wellness testing you need quickly at an
affordable price.

HealthLabs.com offers an expansive collection of lab test categories and test types at discounted
rates.
* Simply order your blood or urine tests online
* Visit a [local lab][81] near you to give your blood work or urine sample for testing
* And confidentially receive your results in 1-3 days in your secure HealthLabs.com account

Your health is important! Our blood chemistry tests and [wellness tests][82] can help lead to
diagnoses and can point out any potentially problematic results that you can then take to your
doctor or general physician. Order the testing you need and receive your results quickly. We work
with major laboratories, like LabCorp and Quest Diagnostics, as well as smaller, local labs. These
labs are all CLIA-certified and often are the same labs your doctor uses!

Our online lab testing is great for monitoring conditions, disorders and diseases as well as aiding
in helping to make a diagnosis or helping to rule out various diagnoses. We have hundreds of lab
tests to choose. Some of our popular tests include:
* [Cholesterol / Lipid Panel][83]
* [Standard Health Test Panel][84]
* [Comprehensive Health Testing][85]
* [Allergy Testing][86]
* [Vitamin Deficiency Testing][87]
* [STD Testing][88]

Whether you need hormone testing, [food allergy testing][89], low-T or testosterone testing, or even
basic wellness done, HealthLabs.com's direct access testing can help you get answers to some of the
important health questions you have.

## Regenerative Medicine and Longevity

Modern longevity medicine is built on a deeper understanding of how the body repairs and regenerates
itself. At My Concierge MD, Dr. David Nazarian integrates regenerative medicine with traditional
internal medicine and advanced preventive diagnostics to help patients improve recovery, reduce
inflammation, and support long-term health.

As a board-certified internist practicing concierge medicine in Beverly Hills, Dr. Nazarian
evaluates each patient’s metabolic health, hormone balance, cardiovascular risk factors, and
lifestyle patterns before recommending regenerative therapies. Treatment options may include exosome
therapy, growth factor injections, peptide protocols, hormone optimization, and advanced
longevity-focused interventions, all selected based on clinical evaluation and evidence-based
guidelines.

Rather than waiting for illness to develop, Dr. Nazarian’s approach focuses on early detection,
cellular health, and metabolic optimization, helping patients maintain energy, cognitive
performance, and physical resilience as they age.

For many patients, regenerative and longevity medicine represents a shift from reactive healthcare
to proactive health optimization designed to extend both lifespan and healthspan.

[A man in light gray scrubs stands on a balcony holding a black mug, with trees and greenery in the
background.]

## Our Philosophy

At My Concierge MD, healthcare begins with understanding the whole patient. Dr. Nazarian conducts
comprehensive evaluations that consider genetics, metabolic health, lifestyle factors, stress
levels, nutrition, and long-term health goals. This broader perspective allows him to design highly
personalized treatment plans that evolve with each patient over time.

# Your mobile  IV rehydration therapy & Wellness service

[BOOK NOW][11]

Elevate your wellness with mobile IV hydration therapy from North Georgia IV and Wellness.
Experience revitalizing treatments delivered to your doorstep, recharging your body and mind
on-demand. Say goodbye to fatigue and dehydration as our experienced professionals bring hydration
and rejuvenation directly to you. Discover the convenience and revitalization of concierge mobile IV
hydration today!

[Untitled design - 2024-01-18T140414.998.png]
[8DC5C0FA-A9C5-446E-B358-52DF1BBAED9B.jpeg]

###### ABOUT US

# Hi. We’re  Rob & Ashley

We have been in the medical field with a combined total of over two decades of experience in
anesthesia, pediatric ER, and preop. We started getting IV drips to help us hydrate and feel better.
But you know what? Who wants to get in a car when you don’t feel good to get an IV? Or, you may just
want to be on your couch with your dog under a blanket. That’s where we come in. We are a concierge
mobile IV service. Whether you are trying to get a beauty bag, a hangover bag, or a variety of
wellness IV bags, we are here to help. These IVs fill you up from the inside out and can really make
a difference in your skin, your mental clarity, or your overall being. So, let us help you to get
back to being present, being well, and being hydrated.

###### STEP BY STEP

# THE  NORTH GEORGIA  IV PROCESS

#### 01

Choose your favorite Drip

At North Georgia IV and Wellness, we offer a range of drips to suit your needs. Whether you're
looking for a boost of energy, hydration, or immunity support, we have a drip that's perfect for
you.

 

#### 02

Secure your slot:

Ready to secure your spot at North Georgia IV and Wellness? Great! We know your time is valuable, so
we're happy to introduce our easy and secure booking process.



#### 03

Confirm your reservation:

Thank you for choosing North Georgia IV and Wellness. We are excited to help you on your journey to
optimal health and wellness. Please confirm your reservation below so we can prepare for your visit.

#### 04

We bring services to you.

At North Georgia IV and Wellness, we understand that taking care of your health can be challenging
with a busy schedule. That's why we bring our services directly to you, wherever you are. We offer
IV therapy and wellness services right to your doorstep.

#### 05

Enjoy your luxury drip!:

Congratulations! You've just received a luxurious IV drip from North Georgia IV and Wellness. We
hope you enjoy the benefits of this treatment and look forward to helping you on your wellness
journey.

 

[png-01_edited_edited.png]

## Pharmaceutical Market Data Is Fragmented

Pharmaceutical pricing, registrations, shortages, and supplier data are spread across national
databases, regulatory agencies, and market reports. For procurement teams and pharmaceutical
traders, gathering this information can take hours or days.

Fragmented landscape slows decision-making and limits visibility into international opportunities.

### TEAMS MUST OFTEN
* Search multiple regulatory databases
* Compare pricing between markets
* Identify licensed suppliers
* Monitor product shortages
* Track product registrations and competition

## Meet A Single Platform for Pharmaceutical Market Intelligence

PharmaFootpath aggregates pharmaceutical market data from official sources and organizes it in a
searchable cloud platform. Users can explore pharmaceutical markets in seconds, not hours.

[pill icon]

### Drug Price Comparison

Compare drug prices by country and spot new market opportunities.

[suppliers icon]

### Supplier Discovery

Find licensed distributors and wholesalers globally.

[shortage icon]

### Shortage Monitoring

Monitor medicine shortages and supply disruptions worldwide.

[arrows icon]

### Regulatory Intelligence

Access product registrations and parallel trade licenses.

## See how PharmaFootpath works in your market

Schedule a Demo

## Get Market Clarity in Seconds

### Product Explorer

Review the registration information for multiple countries in a single unified database. Filter
information by MA holders, countries, presentations, strengths, pack sizes, and other
characteristics.

### Price Comparison

Prices are converted to the currency of your choice, with daily updated currency exchange rates.
This lets you compare prices globally in a single screen, immediately.

Order information by prices, or by the largest changes in prices over the last 30 days.

### Clinical Trial Register

Search through multiple clinical trial registers in a single interface, connected to the drug
registration data and market data of PharmaFootpath.

This helps you to select a drug name or API, and then review global clinical trials currently
running with this.

### Drug Shortage Monitoring

Monitoring drug shortages is an important task, but the volume of information can be difficult to
manage.

PharmaFootpath collects and structures shortage information into a single interface, monitoring
trends to highlight the API with which there are increasing supply disruption signals.

## Built for Pharmaceutical Trade and Procurement

### Procurement Teams

Procurement teams can efficiently search multiple markets, compare pricing, and identify suppliers.

### Parallel Traders

Parallel traders can track product registrations, monitor competition, and find arbitrage
opportunities across EU markets.

### Clinical Trial Supply Teams

Clinical trial supply teams can identify global product availability and find new sourcing
opportunities.

### Pharmaceutical Wholesalers

Pharmaceutical wholesalers can find new suppliers, partners, and international trade opportunities.

## Find sourcing opportunities across global pharmaceutical markets

Schedule a Demo

## Official Pharmaceutical Sources

PharmaFootpath gathers pharmaceutical market data from official national organizations, regulatory
databases, and verified sources. Shortage data is updated daily, and most datasets are refreshed
weekly, so users have the latest information.
* Pharmaceutical pricing
* Product registrations
* Shortages and supply disruptions
* Clinical trials
* Supplier licenses

dermal filler is an injectable treatment made of hyaluronic acid, a naturally

### [PDO THREADS][53]

a collagen boosting treatment that can provide a natural lift to tissues and improve elasticity and
texture of the skin. pdo threads are made of a complex sugar that dissolves over the course of 6 to
8 months, leaving behind collagen for continual benefits.

[Learn More ][54]

### [CHEMICAL PEELS][55]

an effective skin treatment customized to your unique skin needs that can improve tone, texture, and
treat conditions such as acne, melasma, and scarring.

[Learn More ][56]

### [LIP FILLER][57]

a cosmetic injectable  treatment with hyaluronic acid, to add volume, shape, and definition to the
lips. It enhances lip symmetry, smooths fine lines around the mouth, and can create a fuller, more
youthful appearance. The results are natural-looking and usually lasting between 6 to 18 months,
with minimal downtime.

[Learn More ][58]

### [DIAMONDGLOW][59]

a facial treatment that exfoliates, extracts, and infuses the skin with customized serums in one
step. Using a diamond-tipped wand, it gently removes dead skin cells while simultaneously
deep-cleaning pores and delivering nourishing serums tailored to the skin's needs. This treatment
leaves the skin smoother, brighter, and more hydrated, with immediate visible results and no
downtime.

[Learn More ][60]

### [KYBELLA][61]

Kybella is a non-surgical injectable treatment designed to reduce submental fat, commonly known as a
double chin. It contains deoxycholic acid, which breaks down and absorbs fat cells, resulting in a
more contoured and defined jawline over time. The treatment is permanent, as the destroyed fat cells
do not return.

[Learn More ][62]

### [MICRONEEDLING][63]

Microneedling is a minimally invasive skin treatment that uses tiny, fine needles to create
micro-injuries on the skin's surface. This process stimulates the body's natural healing response,
boosting collagen and elastin production. It's commonly used to improve the appearance of fine
lines, acne scars, uneven texture, and overall skin tone. The result is smoother, firmer, and more
youthful-looking skin, with minimal downtime after the procedure.

[Learn More ][64]

## FAQ

### What makes Thorne supplements high quality?

Thorne is committed to producing high-quality supplements through rigorous testing, selective and
well-researched ingredient sourcing, and strict manufacturing standards. We avoid unnecessary
additives, binders, and fillers that may interfere with nutrient absorption. To confirm the purity
of our ingredients, the potency of our formulas, and the absence of all contaminants, we carry out a
minimum of four rounds of testing on every product we manufacture. What’s more, our manufacturing
and warehouse facilities are inspected and certified by independent, third-party organizations,
ensuring compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP). You can read more about
Thorne’s unparalleled quality standards here: https://www.thorne.com/quality.

### Are Thorne supplements clinically tested and safe?

Thorne partners with clinical researchers and conducts clinical trials to support the efficacy of
our ingredients and products. Our team of doctors and medical experts substantiate each ingredient
in every formula we manufacture based on extensive clinical research and medical literature. At any
given time, numerous Thorne products are being tested in clinical trials around the world. Our
collaborations with independent researchers help us understand supplement interactions in the body
while exploring new potential for our formulas. We invest in clinical research to pursue ever higher
standards for supplement safety and efficacy.

### Why are Thorne products more expensive than other supplements?

When it comes to the health of our customers, we never settle for “good enough.” Thorne’s products
may be priced higher than some other supplements because of our commitment to quality at every step.
We don’t simply meet the standard for excellence in dietary supplements – we set the standard. In
addition to our ingredient sourcing and strict manufacturing standards, we invest in rigorous
testing in our state-of-the-art in-house laboratories and in third-party certifications. Our
commitment to quality at every level contributes to the overall value and reliability of our
products for your health.

### Where are Thorne supplements made and where are the ingredients sourced from?

Located in Summerville, South Carolina, Thorne manufactures supplements in the USA using globally
sourced ingredients. When it comes to ingredient sourcing, we seek out only the highest-quality
ingredients, selecting each one for its purity and effectiveness. We maintain oversight of each
ingredient’s origin, providing us complete supply chain transparency. Some ingredients are derived
from natural sources, some are fermented, and others are synthesized to be bio-identical and highly
absorbable. Learn more about the ingredients we use here: https://www.thorne.com/ingredients

Why bother

## You have the labs. You don't have *clarity*.

You drew blood. You got back twelve numbers, three red flags, and the feeling that everything is
fine and everything is wrong at the same time. That's the part we rewrite.

01 · Anxiety with no anchor

### The "normal range" isn't *your* range.

Lab reference intervals are built for an averaged population. Your age, sex, lifestyle, history —
none of that fits inside the bracket.

**Before:** "FERRITIN: 28 ng/mL · LOW"
**After:** "second drop in a quarter for you — recheck in 8 weeks"
02 · Charts with no meaning

### Is the line going up *good* or bad?

Most services hand you a stock-ticker chart. But health isn't a portfolio, and "trending up" isn't
always a win.

**Before:** 12-point chart, "↑ +34%"
**After:** "B12 has risen four months running — supplements are working, you can step down the dose"
03 · Advice with no owner

### Recommendations from *nowhere*.

An AI can fire off 14 tips in two seconds. But who decided they fit you? Who's going to do them? Who
checks they worked?

**Before:** "drink 2L of water and move more"
**After:** an 8-week plan with one task per week, and the owner is you
How it works

## Four steps from *PDF* to clarity.

Upload to understanding takes about fifteen minutes. You don't need to read the panel — that's our
job.

01 · INTAKE

#### Five minutes about *you*

Age, sex, goals, lifestyle. Enough for the report to talk to you, not to a "typical patient."

02 · UPLOAD

#### Drop the *PDF*

Any lab, any format. We pick out up to 340 markers. Nothing to type by hand.

03 · READ

#### A report in *sentences*

Not a table — a calm read. What matters, what waits, what to bring up with your doctor.

04 · PLAN

#### One thing *this week*

One task at a time. A vitamin, a recheck in 8 weeks, a consult. No checklist burnout.

systems, and the markers that need attention. Share a link with your doctor or download the PDF —
one click.
